Purpose: Machine-readable qualification gates of a coupon's response matrices against its graded_v2 reference (supervisor decision 48 and the 2026-09-20 gate confirmation): the class statements of the geometry-independence suite's physics table, evaluated on the free view. Changing a threshold means editing this frozen file; every qualification record carries its SHA-256.
FreeView: every source of the reference that is not a contract ZeroTraceIndices knot (PEC-constrained library knots whose 3D coupon energies are nonzero) and whose reference and run diagonal domain energies are nonzero
RelativeOffset: (run - reference) / |reference| of the per-source diagonal quantities: E = Q_ii (domain), p_X = Q_total_ii(X) / E_ii for the interfaces MA / MS / SA
InterfaceTypes: the interface index -> type map is read from the run config's Boundaries.Postprocessing.Dielectric entries (Index, Type), never assumed; a participation p_X sums the whole-interface diagonal energies of every postprocessed interface of type X (a multi-slot coupon postprocesses one interface per slot and type)
ReferenceAnchor: the reference's own Solver.Order (recorded per case as 'vs p<order> anchor'); the reference is a discretization anchor, not a converged limit

SourceClasses.Rule: classify_sources.py geometric classes from the trace apexes and the plan-view boundary (never a hand list); the two thresholds below decide wide vs narrow and near-junction, hence the E gate's scope, and are frozen here with the gates
SourceClasses.NarrowHatWidth: a hat narrower than NarrowHatWidthMicrons (distance from the apex to the nearest apex on the same z level) is a narrow hat, never a wide-class source
SourceClasses.JunctionReach: a source closer than JunctionReachMicrons to a metal-edge / cut junction is a junction-class source, never a wide-class source

E.Statement: every source of the wide classes within 1% of the reference domain energy
E.Report: the all-free within-1% count and the worst free source

p_MA.Statement: free signed median within 1%, reference-p_MA-weighted mean within 1%, every strongest-reference-MA source within 2%, every free source within 5%
p_MA.QuantityRule: user decision 60(1) / supervisor decision 61a: the MA statements are evaluated on the sharp-edge extrapolated participation p_MA_sharp = (MA_raw + MA_tail) / E of the run (ma_tail.py: MA_raw the sum of the per-ring MA shells, MA_tail the `Consistent` estimator - the top edge's -2/3 law anchored on ring 2 with the ring-1 factor measured on this run, the bottom edge's own rings-2..4 law) against the reference's sharp-edge p_MA: extrapolated by the same rule when its ring / edge sizing is recorded, else modelled from its edge size via the eps^(1/3) law and annotated 'reference unextrapolated' (raw-vs-raw is recorded next to it); a run without radial shells is gated on the raw p_MA and says so
p_MA.StrongestRule: the 20 strongest reference-MA free sources, or every free source when fewer than 20

p_MS.Statement: free |median| within 1%, every free source within 5%

p_SA.Statement: at least 2/3 of the free sources within 2% and at least 90% within 5% (the EL4c level: 40 / 56 of 60)

PSequenceControls.Statement: for every control source the p-step d45 = (p_high - p_main) / |p_high| of the domain energy is within 1% and that of every participation p_MA_sharp / p_MS / p_SA within 5% (controls at the orders below and above the main order)
PSequenceControls.MAObservableRule: decision 61a: the p-sequence gate on the MA evaluates the sharp-edge extrapolated p_MA_sharp (the tail measured at each order from that order's own shells) in place of the raw p_MA, whose step is dominated by the innermost ring's resolution; the raw p_MA step is still recorded

LibraryContinuity.Statement: every pair / stack model whose consecutive edge separations are all at or above 2R (1 - ThresholdBandOverR) responds per edge and per unit length like the isolated-edge model within MaximumRelativeOffset (decision 82(4): the strict interaction rule at 2R is continuous only if the pair model at the threshold equals two isolated edges)
LibraryContinuity.Quantity: per edge: sum of the diagonal domain-response entries Q_ii of the basis points nearest to the edge line, divided by the edge length (library_continuity.py)
LibraryContinuity.Scope: runs on the written process-library.json of every qualify run (NotApplicable without a pair / stack at the threshold or without an isolated-edge model); synthetic library data tests in test_library_continuity.py

Verdicts.Passed: every gate with a reference passed and every p-sequence control passed
Verdicts.Failed: a gate or a p-sequence control failed on a complete run (with or without a reference)
Verdicts.PendingQualification: no reference matrices for this coupon and every p-sequence control passed: the matrices carry their own convergence control but no accuracy statement; never Passed
